principle: Do not force DAYI, SALI and SARU into one grammar. Preserve their L03 lexical authority and separate semantic behavior.

recommendedSequence.reason: DAYI has CANDIDATE lexical authority and can be compared against existing MORAKU exact-frame evidence without conflating the two.
SALI remains WATCH and should be treated more conservatively; compare against KORUME/VEMI only as bounded evidence.
SARU requires independent position/scope decisions and must preserve the explicit NOT usually boundary.
